description: Equipment and consumables. Filled by the cycle 2 bridge prefab dump. SCHEMA_VERSION 4, cycle 3 phase 2: adds ability_group_guids, the L1 link from a weapon to the abilities it grants. It copies ADR-006's station_guids shape exactly - plural, and an empty list ships as [] so 'grants no ability' stays distinguishable from 'the join did not run'. THE CHAIN, every hop read off an enumerated component list in phase 1: item prefab -> ProjectM.EquippableData.BuffGuid -> the EquipBuff_Weapon_<Family>_Base entity -> DynamicBuffer<ProjectM.ReplaceAbilityOnSlotBuff> -> element .NewGroupId is the ability GROUP and .Slot is the bar slot. The item itself carries NO ability reference, which is why the equip buff is the only route. Note the ASYMMETRY, which is not a contradiction: EquippableData.BuffGuid is BARRED as a route to item STATS, because ModifyUnitStatBuff_DOTS sits on the item prefab itself and cycle 2 settled that; for ABILITIES the equip buff is the only route and the right one. SCHEMA_VERSION 3 amended 2026-07-26: tier stopped being required. It was FABRICATED as 0 on every one of the 425 rows in the first real dump, and an exhaustive field scan across all 169 interop assemblies for build 1.1.13.0-r99712 returned 67 Tier-shaped fields with ZERO on a per-item-prefab component. Rarity returns zero hits anywhere in ProjectM, and ProjectM.ItemData, the real item-definition component, has no tier field. tier stays DECLARED so validate_table still type-checks it and existing fixtures still pass, but the dumper now OMITS it rather than emit a placeholder a cycle 3 consumer would read as real. REJECTED near-miss, recorded so it is not re-proposed: ArmorLevelSource.Level is exactly 10x tier on 117 of 425 rows, but that divisor is calibrated against the _T0x prefab-name token, the value is already published as gear_score, and headgear, cloaks and bags carry no level component at all, leaving 74 rows unsourced. SCHEMA_VERSION 2 amended 2026-07-26 after the first real dump: stats was an object mapping a stat name to a number, and it is now a list, because a name-keyed map cannot carry ModificationType. MEASURED over 425 items and 899 stat entries: three modification kinds occur - Add 665, AddToBase 232, MultiplyBaseAdd 2 - so PhysicalPower Add 10 and PhysicalPower AddToBase 10 are different stats that a map would render identically. NOT the reason: duplicate StatType collapse. Zero of the 425 items carry a repeated StatType on this build, so that argument was checked and found false rather than assumed true. UNVALIDATED NESTED SHAPE still applies: validate_table checks only that stats is a list; core/table_deep.py is what inspects the entries.

localization_guid.description: Key into strings.json, a dashed lowercase UUID. OMITTED until the dumper performs the runtime read, because MEASURED 2026-07-26 the join does not exist offline: all 8379 strings.json keys are dashed UUIDs, and zero of 425 item rows join by prefab name, by prefab_guid in decimal, or in any of six hex forms. The route is GameDataSystem.ManagedDataRegistry.TryGet<ManagedItemData>(PrefabGUID) then .Name.Key.ToGuid().ToString(), NOT PrefabLookupMap, which carries no localization member.

category.description: weapon, chest, legs, gloves, boots, cloak, jewel, consumable, other.

tier.description: Gear tier. OPTIONAL and currently NEVER EMITTED: no per-item-prefab tier component exists on build 1.1.13.0-r99712. Absent means unsourced, not zero. Do NOT derive it from the _T0x prefab-name token and do NOT derive it from ArmorLevelSource.Level; see the schema description for why both were rejected on evidence.

stats.description: One entry per ModifyUnitStatBuff_DOTS element on the item prefab, read one hop with no BuffGuid follow. Each entry is an object with stat (StatType name), modification (ModificationType name) and value (number). Observed 2026-07-26: 0 to 6 entries per item, 29 distinct StatTypes, values 0 to 500.

weapon_type.description: Weapon family when category is weapon, otherwise empty.

ability_group_guids.description: PrefabGUID hashes of the ability GROUPS this item grants when equipped, sorted ascending and deduplicated. Joins ability_stats.prefab_guid. Emitted as [] when the equip-buff chain ran and found none, and OMITTED only when EquippableData could not be read at all - the same measured-empty versus not-measured distinction ADR-006 rules for recipes.station_guids. The bar SLOT that ReplaceAbilityOnSlotBuff also carries is deliberately not kept: this table's job is the link, and a slot is a loadout fact the combat-math spec has not yet defined a use for.
